critique: The seamless integration of a mathematically rendered Renaissance cathedral—featuring WebGL arches, floor tiles, and fresco marbling—with slow-drifting liquid CSS blobs and precise SVG orbital geometry creates a surreal, temporally displaced atmosphere. However, the inclusion of raw external images (`art.png` and `guineapig.png`) feels jarring against the procedural environment; replacing them with generative cyber-organic forms or stylized algorithmic artifacts would create a much more cohesive, self-contained composition.
